recommended_certs.rationale: セキュア SDLC の CSSLP から、クラウドセキュリティオートメーションの GCSA へ — DevSecOps エンジニアの組み合わせ。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Container, Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code coverage supports professional security-automation decisions at three years; recorded accreditation strengthens credibility, while a costly open-book exam does not demonstrate expert execution.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accreditation, recorded COOL recognition and Kubernetes, containers and IaC coverage support professional DevSecOps responsibility. The open-book exam provides less direct implementation evidence than a lab, and its cost does not establish expert depth.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded Kubernetes, containers and IaC focus spans practical DevSecOps delivery concerns at a three-year level. The professional hints and accreditation support that placement, while an unspecified practical component prevents expert credit.
